evidence.quote: OCUs are billed on an hourly basis on a collection group level with per-second granularity. There is no minimum OCU requirement - Indexing and Search OCUs scale to zero after 10 minutes of inactivity.
With Amazon OpenSearch Serverless NextGen collections, you only pay for the resources consumed by the workload.

note: d013, d022 | adjudicate-35 moved from condition (not carried by the quote): Storage is billed separately for hot storage in gigabyte-months.
